title: 第19章 舔狗舔到最后一无所有第20章 五大皇子
slug: 我纨绔世子开局征服太子妃
content_zh:
额？
这道声音里毫不掩饰的亲昵和激动，让楚风下意识地循声望去。
不远处，一位身着华贵锦袍的青年，在一群护卫的簇拥下正快步走来。
青年面如冠玉，气质儒雅，脸上挂着温和的笑容，径直走向萧霓凰，那双眼睛里满是毫不掩饰的爱慕之情。
“霓凰，你终于回来了，这一路辛苦了。”
来人正是大乾三皇子，陆丰。
他一开口，便直接无视了旁边还站着的楚风，眼中只有萧霓凰。
闻言，萧霓凰那英气的眉梢几不可察地蹙了一下。
她平静地注视着陆丰，语气疏离却不失礼节：“三殿下还是直呼我名字吧，以免引起不必要的误会。”
一句话，干脆利落，在两人之间划开了一道清晰的界限。
陆丰脸上的笑容僵了一瞬，但很快又恢复如常，语气里满是关切：“我听说你回京途中遭遇了伏击，可有受伤？那些贼人抓到了吗？你放心，我一定会彻查此事，给你一个交代！”
这番嘘寒问暖，不知道的，还真以为他跟萧霓凰关系匪浅。
“喂。”
一个懒洋洋的声音不合时宜地响起，打破了这“深情”
的氛围。
楚风掏了掏耳朵，懒散地往前一步，正好不偏不倚地挡在了陆丰和萧霓凰中间，斜着眼睛看他：“三殿下，当着我这个正牌未婚夫的面，就这么关心我的未婚妻，是不是有点……不太好啊？”
唰！
此话一出，陆丰才终于正眼看向了楚风，那眼神里充满了毫不掩饰的蔑视和不屑，深处还藏着一丝怨毒。
“楚世子，本殿下是在关心霓凰，与你何干？”
陆丰的声音冷了下来，带着皇子的高傲，“你扪心自问，你配得上霓凰么？”

“你若还有半点自知之明，就该立刻向镇北王提议，解除这门婚约。”
“只有本殿下才配得上霓凰！
你，不配！”
话音刚落，周围的空气都冷了几分。
楚风被他这番话给逗乐了，他还是第一次见到有人把挖墙脚说得这么理直气壮，真当他是泥捏的菩萨，没点脾气？
不过，没等楚风开口，萧霓凰冰冷的声音却先一步响起。
她清冷的视线落在陆丰脸上，一字一句，清晰无比：“他配不配得上，是我和镇北王府的事，与三殿下无关。
我们的婚约，更由不得外人插手，霓凰多谢三殿下的关心，但还请三殿下自重！”
此话一出，陆丰的脸色瞬间变得十分难看。
“听到了么？”
楚风笑嘻嘻地凑上前，像个老大哥一样拍了拍陆丰的肩膀，语重心长地说道：“三殿下，别做舔狗了，舔到最后一无所有。”
“你！”
陆丰气得脸色铁青，浑身发抖，他堂堂皇子，何曾受过这等羞辱。
萧霓凰则直接翻身上马，对着亲卫下令：“回府！”
“驾！”
一声令下，一行人干脆利落地离开了此地。
楚风冲着陆丰耸了耸肩，吹着口哨，也转身跟了上去。
原地，只剩下陆丰一人，他死死地攥着拳头，指甲深陷入掌心，那双原本温润的眼睛里，此刻翻涌着阴鸷与怨毒。
“楚……风……”
两个字，从他牙缝里挤了出来，带着森然的杀意。
content_en:
Forehead?
The unabashed intimacy and excitement in this voice made Chu Feng follow it subconsciously.
Not far away, a young man wearing a luxurious brocade robe was walking quickly, surrounded by a group of guards.
The young man had an elegant face and elegant temperament. With a gentle smile on his face, he walked straight towards Xiao Nihuang, his eyes full of unabashed admiration.
"Nihuang, you're finally back. It's been a hard journey."
The person who came was none other than the third prince of Daqian, Lu Feng.
As soon as he opened his mouth, he ignored Chu Feng who was still standing next to him, and only had Xiao Nihuang in his eyes.
Hearing this, Xiao Nihuang's heroic brows frowned almost imperceptibly.
She looked at Lu Feng calmly, and her tone was distant but polite: "Your Highness, please call me by my first name to avoid unnecessary misunderstandings."
One sentence, crisp and clear, drew a clear line between the two.
The smile on Lu Feng's face froze for a moment, but soon returned to normal, his tone full of concern: "I heard that you were ambushed on your way back to Beijing. Were you injured? Have the thieves been caught? Don't worry, I will investigate the matter thoroughly and give you an explanation!"
For those who didn't know this, I really thought he had a close relationship with Xiao Nihuang.
"Hello."
A lazy voice sounded at an inappropriate time, breaking this "affectionate" moment
atmosphere.
Chu Feng picked his ears, lazily took a step forward, and stood squarely between Lu Feng and Xiao Nihuang. He looked at him sideways and said, "Third Highness, in front of me, your real fiancé, you care so much about my fiancée. Isn't it a bit... not good?"
Uh-huh!
As soon as these words came out, Lu Feng finally looked at Chu Feng, his eyes full of unabashed contempt and disdain, with a trace of resentment hidden deep down.
"Chu Shizi, my highness is concerned about Nihuang, what does it have to do with you?"
Lu Feng's voice became colder, with the arrogance of a prince, "Ask yourself, are you worthy of Nihuang?"
"If you still have any self-awareness, you should immediately propose to King Zhenbei to terminate this engagement."
“Only Your Highness is worthy of Nihuang!
You don't deserve it! "
As soon as he finished speaking, the air around him became a bit colder.
Chu Feng was amused by his words. This was the first time he saw someone talking about poaching so confidently. Do you really think he is a Bodhisattva who has no temper?
However, before Chu Feng could speak, Xiao Nihuang's cold voice sounded first.
Her cold gaze fell on Lu Feng's face, and she said every word with incomparable clarity: "Whether he is worthy or not is a matter between me and the Zhenbei Palace, and has nothing to do with His Highness.
Our engagement is not allowed to be interfered with by outsiders. Nihuang thanks the Third Highness for your concern, but please respect yourself! "
As soon as these words came out, Lu Feng's face instantly became very ugly.
"Did you hear that?"
Chu Feng stepped forward with a smile, patted Lu Feng on the shoulder like a big brother, and said sincerely: "Your Highness, please stop being a licking dog. You will lose everything after licking."
"You!"
Lu Feng was so angry that his face was livid and his whole body was shaking. He, a noble prince, had never suffered such humiliation before.
Xiao Nihuang immediately got on his horse and ordered to his guards: "Go back home!"
"Drive!"
After giving the order, the group left the place neatly.
Chu Feng shrugged at Lu Feng, whistled, and turned to follow.
Lu Feng was the only one left on the spot. He clenched his fists tightly and dug his fingernails into his palms. His originally gentle eyes were filled with evil and resentment.
"Chu...feng..."
Two words squeezed out from between his teeth, with a fierce murderous intent.
